acceptance.given: The skill-authoring standard is authored or evaluated.

oracle.expected: The standard declares one primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
forbidden: The standard omits any of the nine required declaration areas.
oracle.observable: The standard document contains declarations for all nine required areas.

acceptance.then: All nine required declaration areas are present.
acceptance.when: When reviewing the standard document against the required declaration set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Review the standard document against the nine required areas and fail if any area is not declared.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define the nine required skill-authoring areas in the standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only; reverting removes the required-area declarations.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from unchecked required areas to declaring the complete set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The standard document declares all nine required areas.
